results.title: Eastern Washington lets 21-point lead slip in 34-27 loss at Northern Arizona
results.description: FLAGSTAFF, Ariz. — Eastern Washington built a 21-point lead in the first half but could not complete a potential game-tying drive in the final minutes, falling 34-27 to Northern Arizona in Saturday night's Big Sky and season opener.

results.title: Dawgs Sweep SDSU For 2-0 Start
results.description: One night after a comeback victory in the season opener, Husky Volleyball (2-0) turned in a strong performance against the San Diego State Aztecs in a straight-set sweep. The Husky sweep came in front of 2,564 fans at Alaska Airlines Arena by a 25-17, 26-24, 25-20 final tally.

results.title: Phillies score 3 runs in 10th, hold off Angels
Djokovic 'prepared' for US Open bid for history
results.description: "Obviously longevity was always one of the goals when I was younger, trying to have long career, trying to have more shots at Grand Slams, and stay healthy long enough so that I can perform for as many years as possible," Djokovic said.
